Authors: Min Cai (University of Alberta), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (Independent Researcher), and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Amii). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

3. **EAU paper overview and extracted results** — A searchable summary with figures and tables comparing EAU on UserGym, ColBench, and τ²-Bench. Same authors and affiliations as above. [The Latest in AI](https://thelatestinai.com/papers/2610.16523)

2. **EAU paper on arXiv** — Primary paper describing the environment–agent–user co-evolution framework for training user-centric LLM agents. Submitted October 12, 2026.  
   **People/affiliations:** Same six authors and affiliations listed above; Min Cai and Dan Zhang are equal contributors.  
   **URL:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

3. **Min Cai’s research page** — Lead author’s page, which identifies EAU as current work on co-evolving agents with their learning environments.  
   **Person:** Min Cai, PhD student at the University of Alberta, advised by Xi Ye; previously a research intern at Baidu and Z.ai.  
   **URL:** [https://henrycai11.github.io/](https://henrycai11.github.io/)

4. **Pith paper record and automated review** — An independent AI-generated critique of EAU, highlighting its empirical gains while questioning whether comparisons use matched compute budgets.  
   **People:** Min Cai, Dan Zhang, Gao Xing, Libin Ma, Zhaohui Xu, and Xi Ye; affiliated with the University of Alberta, National University of Singapore, Kuaishou Technology, Amii, or listed as independent, as mapped above.  
   **URL:** [https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

query: framework jointly adapts simulated user environment rewards RL configuration
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — Exact match. EAU adapts the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration during training.  
   **People:** Min Cai and Xi Ye — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — National University of Singapore; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — independent researcher; Xi Ye also — Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii).  
   **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523

2. **UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning** — Closely related framework combining simulated users, standardized environments, and configurable reward formulations for multi-turn RL.  
   **People:** Cheng Qian and Heng Ji — University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang — Salesforce AI Research.  
   **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19736

3. **Reinforcement Learning-Based Framework for the Intelligent Adaptation of User Interfaces** — A configurable Gym-based RL environment using predictive HCI models as reward signals.  
   **People:** Daniel Gaspar-Figueiredo — Universitat Politècnica de València and ITI; Marta Fernández-Diego, Silvia Abrahão, and Emilio Insfrán — Universitat Politècnica de València; Ruben Nuredini — Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences.  
   **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.09255
